text:
Naked and vertical, but girded,

the line of the earth to the indolence

of a flesh that yields, when the perfection

of dream begins its measure.


Matter without love, but kindled

by the faithful number of purity,

where cold flesh is dressed

without the taste of time and life.


O docile to the eyes and set apart

from the fire of blood, mute glory

in ecstasy of lifted earth!


Ancient youth, fresh and worn,

that afflicts the passion of its memory

in this eternity so calm.

translation.title: To a Statue of a Nude Woman
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps this cleaner-spaced variant of the statue sonnet distinct from the related source record.
